contract.canonicalJson: UTF-8; recursively lexicographic object keys; no insignificant whitespace or BOM; arrays retain declared order; one terminal LF only for artifact files; pair digest excludes terminal LF and is SHA-256 of canonical pair object bytes
identityRules: source path, line, evidence reference, entity, action, role, polarity and condition are excluded from pair identity
declaring/reference types use JVM binary names
generic arguments must already be erased; scorer rejects noncanonical values
parameter order and return type are identity-significant
occurrenceRules: proposal occurrenceIndex must be contiguous zero-based artifact array order
proof binds exactly one occurrenceId and pairDigest
missing, duplicate or orphan proof is INVALID
first fully valid occurrence can match one gold pair; later same-pair occurrences are FP_DUPLICATE
disposition-invalid occurrence never consumes gold credit
chainRules: chainRequired true ordered digests exactly cover necessary gold set without duplicate
truth edges exactly equal N-1 adjacent ordered edges
omitted, extra, reversed or nonadjacent truth edge is INVALID
chainRequired false has no chain or edge and is excluded from denominator
extra unsupported proposal is FP but cannot erase a matched necessary chain
metricRules: every proposal occurrence exactly TP or FP
every gold pair exactly MATCHED or FN
scenario coverage counts valid scenarios with any structurally valid proposal occurrence
UNRESOLVED and unsupported preserve scenario/gold denominators and FN
zero denominator returns null plus reason code
post-dispatch mandatory null metric or malformed evidence is INVALID
repositoryRules: per-repository raw counts and metrics required
macro uses equal repository weight and is null if any repository metric unavailable
every repository independently must pass; aggregate cannot mask failure
thresholdDecision: no rounded decimal participates in decision

wilson.outputFormat: fixed decimal string with exactly 12 fractional digits; HALF_EVEN; null plus reason when n is zero
wilson.arithmetic: Java BigDecimal and Python Decimal only. Create x,n,z from exact decimal strings/integers under precision 50 HALF_EVEN. Apply MathContext/context to every multiply, add, subtract, divide and sqrt in the stated parenthesized order.
wilson.serialization: Quantize lower and upper only after all formula steps to scale 12 HALF_EVEN. Do not use binary float at any stage.
wilson.decisionBoundary: Wilson intervals are descriptive and never participate in strict threshold decisions.

vectors.C01_PATH_EXCLUDED: same canonical method with different source path has identical pair bytes and digest
vectors.C02_SNAPSHOT_DISTINCT: same scenario and signature under different repository snapshot has distinct digest
vectors.C04_PRIMITIVE_REFERENCE_ARRAY: primitive, reference, and multidimensional array normalization matches frozen JVM names
vectors.C05_GENERIC_ERASURE: erased generic type is accepted and non-erased input is INVALID
vectors.C06_CONSTRUCTOR: constructor uses methodName <init> and returnType void
vectors.C07_RETURN_TYPE: return type participates in pair identity
vectors.S01_SINGLE_TP: one valid exact occurrence yields TP1 FP0 FN0
vectors.S02_WRONG_PAIR: one valid non-gold occurrence and one unmatched gold yield TP0 FP1 FN1
vectors.S03_DUPLICATE_FP: three identical valid occurrences yield TP1 FP2 FN0 and duplicateCount2
vectors.S04_INVALID_THEN_VALID: first disposition-invalid occurrence yields FP and does not consume gold; second valid occurrence yields TP
vectors.D04_POLARITY: wrong assertion polarity yields FP1 FN1
vectors.D05_CONDITION: wrong business condition yields FP1 FN1
vectors.V01_DUPLICATE_SCENARIO: duplicate canonical scenario ID is INVALID
vectors.V02_WRONG_SNAPSHOT: scenario or pair bound to wrong snapshot is INVALID
vectors.V03_MISSING_TEST_PROVENANCE: missing test provenance digest is INVALID
vectors.V04_MISSING_SOURCE_PROVENANCE: missing source provenance digest is INVALID
vectors.V05_STRATUM_CARDINALITY: missing or multiple coverage strata is INVALID
vectors.V06_MISSING_TRUTH_DISPOSITION: missing sealed truth disposition is INVALID
vectors.V07_MALFORMED_SCHEMA: unknown/missing field or malformed canonical value is INVALID
vectors.V08_ARTIFACT_DIGEST: any mandatory artifact digest mismatch is INVALID
vectors.V09_CROSS_REPOSITORY_REFERENCE: foreign repository pair/proof/chain reference is INVALID
vectors.Z01_EMPTY_PROPOSAL: nonempty gold and empty proposal yields TP0 FP0 FNn, precision null NO_PROPOSED_PAIRS, recall0, provisional INVALID post-dispatch
vectors.Z02_FP_SCENARIO_COVERAGE: one structurally valid non-gold proposal yields scenario coverage 1/1
vectors.A01_UNRESOLVED: UNRESOLVED retains scenario denominator and necessary FN with reason
vectors.A02_UNSUPPORTED: unsupported retains scenario denominator and necessary FN with reason
vectors.CH01_COMPLETE: all ordered necessary pairs and adjacent edges matched yields complete chain
vectors.CH02_MISSING_PROPOSED_EDGE: valid truth with unmatched required proposal edge yields incomplete chain without changing pair counts
vectors.CH03_MISSING_PAIR: missing necessary pair yields FN and incomplete chain
vectors.CH04_NOT_APPLICABLE: chainRequired false requires no chain/edges and is excluded from chain denominator
vectors.CH05_OMITTED_TRUTH_EDGE: omitted adjacent truth edge is INVALID
vectors.CH09_EXTRA_PROPOSAL: extra unsupported pair is FP while fully matched necessary chain remains complete
vectors.R01_TWO_REPOSITORY_PASS: both repositories strictly exceed precision .80 and recall .60
vectors.R02_NON_MASKING: micro aggregate passes but one repository fails; provisional classification REVISE
vectors.R05_REPOSITORY_NULL: mandatory per-repository metric null after dispatch is INVALID
vectors.R06_MACRO_EQUAL_WEIGHT: macro is equal repository weight and differs from micro on unequal sample sizes
vectors.P01_REPEATABILITY: each implementation emits byte-identical canonical output on two runs
vectors.P02_CROSS_IMPLEMENTATION: Java and clean-room Python output bytes equal each other and sealed golden output for all vectors

conformanceContract.coverageRule: Every frozen protocol scoring rule requires at least one positive and one negative vector; missing coverage is PLAN_CONFLICT and implementation cannot start.
conformanceContract.goldenRule: Golden expected bytes/digests are materialized and independently reviewed before production implementation; neither scorer may generate or update golden outputs.

forbidden: implementation, vector, golden, result or review changes
claiming H1 BOUND before post-merge external receipt

forbidden: all implementation, test, vector, result and historical paths

stages.required: Exact envelope materialization and independent review P0/P1/P2 zero; no implementation.
Vector author materializes schema, all synthetic inputs, expected canonical bytes/digests and expected outputs; independent vector review PASS before scorer code.
New Java and Python conformance tests fail for missing implementations; retain logs.
Implement versioned model, canonical identity, artifact IO and fail-closed scenario/truth/proof validation.
Implement exhaustive occurrences, dispositions, chain and coverage after pair classification.
Implement per-repository/micro/macro metrics, Wilson, strict decisions, canonical report and CLI collision behavior.
Separate actor implements stdlib-only recomputer without Java source or output access.
Each scorer twice; each run byte-identical to its first and to sealed golden; Java and Python bytes identical for all vectors.
Focused formal scorer and CLI tests pass with zero failures/errors/skips.
Full Maven package pass with zero failures/errors/skips.
Full Python regression passes including clean-room conformance.
Two clean isolated Java17 builds from exact candidate and identical settings produce identical whole-JAR SHA-256; source-set manifest binds every production input.

External receipt after merge/read-back binds full merge commit, source manifest SHA, reproducible JAR SHA, Python recomputer SHA, vector manifest SHA, protocol SHA and review SHA. H1 remains unbound before this receipt.

Java/Python repeatability and byte parity across every vector

python.verificationCommand: test "$(shasum -a 256 /usr/bin/python3 | awk '{print $1}')" = 0f534e4beb14b610b15eedbb4352c5b305a5795a05527632c8f82c83317f833a && test "$(/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import os,sys; print(os.path.realpath(sys.executable))')" = /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/Library/Frameworks/Python3.framework/Versions/3.9/bin/python3.9 && test "$(shasum -a 256 /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/Library/Frameworks/Python3.framework/Versions/3.9/bin/python3.9 | awk '{print $1}')" = 8e598855de9a6648bc670d5fe7a3a653f1fa967b74373ed7c4ca16fbc40c0de1 && test "$(/usr/bin/python3 --version 2>&1)" = 'Python 3.9.6'

runtimeBindings.executionRule: Fresh preflight must re-read and match every path, version, and SHA-256; mismatch is PLAN_BLOCKED, never substituted.

buildReproducibilityProtocol.candidateBinding: full 40-character implementation candidate commit after code completion
buildReproducibilityProtocol.materialization: Two absent isolated directories, each populated from the exact candidate Git tree without untracked files.
buildReproducibilityProtocol.order: Build A completes before Build B starts; no parallel Maven or heavy JVM.
verification: test counts and zero failures/errors/skips match
whole executable JAR SHA-256 values are identical
source tree and runtime binary SHA-256 values match envelope/candidate receipt
all commands, attempts, exits, timestamps and log SHA-256 values retained
buildReproducibilityProtocol.failure: Any difference is FAILED_EXECUTION; pom or build-plugin changes require a new envelope revision and review.
buildReproducibilityProtocol.epochCommand: CANDIDATE_EPOCH=$(git show -s --format=%ct "$CANDIDATE"); case "$CANDIDATE_EPOCH" in *[!0-9]*|'') exit 1;; esac

rules: one entry for every conformanceContract vector ID
paths unique and within conformance/inputs or conformance/expected
coverage maps every scoring rule ID to at least one positive and one negative vector

sourceSetManifest.scope: every regular file in exact candidate Git tree; no untracked file

rules: reviewer distinct from all producer actors
merge commit full 40 hex and contains exact reviewed candidate tree or documented reviewed integration-only delta
canonical receipt digest independently read back

stageExecutionProtocol.canonicalization: Each receipt is compact UTF-8 sorted-key JSON plus LF; SHA-256 exact bytes. Ledger is append-only, output path absent before first stage, one START and one END per stage.
stageExecutionProtocol.candidateCheck: CANDIDATE=<40hex>; test "$(git rev-parse --verify "$CANDIDATE^{commit}")" = "$CANDIDATE"; test "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" = ''; git diff --name-only 6205a336ffc044365e8f4c29b9a40450d278f689..."$CANDIDATE" must match only ownedPaths and must not match legacyMustRemainByteIdentical
vectorSealCommands: for every sorted vector entry: assert exact input/expected SHA-256, absent real identity tokens, unique IDs/paths, exact catalog equality and positive/negative rule coverage; write vector-review.json before any production source path exists
stageExecutionProtocol.sourceManifestCommand: git ls-tree -r "$CANDIDATE" | while read mode type blob path; do test "$type" = blob; git cat-file blob "$blob" > <scratch-file>; record path/blob/mode/SHA-256/byte-count; done; canonical sort by UTF-8 path; assert entry count equals git ls-tree count; write source-set-manifest.json
parityCommands: run Java scorer independently twice from frozen vector manifest into absent java-run-1.json/java-run-2.json
run /usr/bin/python3 clean-room recomputer independently twice into absent python-run-1.json/python-run-2.json
cmp all four files and sealed expected aggregate byte-for-byte; write parity-receipt.json only if all comparisons pass
reviewAndReceiptOrder: independent-review.json is written only after stages 1-11 and exact candidate read-back
premerge h1-scorer-receipt-candidate.json may bind candidate but effectiveH1State remains UNBOUND
